candidates.name: United Parcel Service, Inc.
candidates.description: Both companies are global leaders in integrated express parcel delivery, logistics, and supply chain solutions.
candidates.rationale: Direct peer competitor in global parcel delivery, logistics, and supply chain services.

candidates.name: DHL Express
candidates.description: Both operate extensive international air and ground networks for express courier and logistics services.
candidates.rationale: Same business model: global express delivery and logistics provider serving similar shippers and enterprise customers.

candidates.name: United States Postal Service
candidates.description: Both provide comprehensive domestic and international mail and package delivery services to residential and commercial customers.
candidates.rationale: Same logistics/delivery business serving similar residential and commercial shipping customers.

candidates.name: GeoPost Group
candidates.description: Both provide large-scale, automated parcel delivery networks across international markets.
candidates.rationale: Global parcel delivery and logistics operator with similar scale, services, and buyer profile to FedEx.

candidates.name: DPD Dynamic Parcel Distribution GmbH & Co. KG
candidates.description: Both offer integrated parcel delivery and logistics services with a focus on speed and network efficiency.
candidates.rationale: Same business model: global parcel delivery and logistics provider serving similar shipping and supply-chain customers.

candidates.name: Aramex
candidates.description: Both specialize in international express shipping, courier services, and global freight forwarding.
candidates.rationale: Same industry and business model: global parcel delivery, courier, freight forwarding, and logistics services.

candidates.name: Kuehne + Nagel Group
candidates.description: Both are major global logistics providers handling air and sea freight alongside contract logistics.
candidates.rationale: Global logistics peer with overlapping freight, shipping, and contract logistics services; same buyer base and business model.

candidates.name: DB Schenker Group
candidates.description: Both provide end-to-end supply chain management, including global freight and logistics solutions.
candidates.rationale: Both are global logistics and freight providers with similar supply-chain, parcel, and transportation services targeting comparable enterprise customers.

candidates.name: DSV
candidates.description: Both operate global transport networks spanning air, sea, and road freight services.
candidates.rationale: Same global logistics and freight transportation business serving similar enterprise shipping and supply-chain customers.

candidates.name: Nippon Express Co., Ltd.
candidates.description: Both offer integrated logistics services including air freight, sea freight, and dedicated express delivery.
candidates.rationale: Global logistics provider with similar freight, parcel, and supply-chain services; clear same-category lookalike for FedEx.

candidates.name: XPO Logistics, Inc.
candidates.description: Both maintain significant operations in less-than-truckload (LTL) freight transportation and logistics management.
candidates.rationale: Same logistics/transportation category with overlapping freight, shipping, and supply-chain customers; a clear peer to FedEx.

candidates.name: J.B. Hunt
candidates.description: Both provide diverse freight transportation and logistics solutions across various modes of transport.
candidates.rationale: Same industry and business model: large transportation and logistics provider serving overlapping shippers and supply-chain buyers.

candidates.name: Saia, Inc.
candidates.description: Both operate significant less-than-truckload (LTL) networks and supply chain support services.
candidates.rationale: Both are logistics carriers with overlapping LTL and supply-chain services, serving similar shipping customers.

candidates.name: C.H. Robinson Company
candidates.description: Both act as major players in the logistics and transportation sector, offering comprehensive freight brokerage and supply chain management.
candidates.rationale: Direct logistics peer to FedEx; similar freight, transportation, and supply-chain services targeting comparable shippers.

candidates.name: Purolator Inc.
candidates.description: Both focus on integrated courier, parcel delivery, and freight shipping services.
candidates.rationale: Same business model: integrated parcel, courier, and freight logistics company serving similar shipping customers.

candidates.name: Canada Post
candidates.description: Both provide essential national postal and parcel delivery services for consumer and commercial segments.
candidates.rationale: Same core business: national parcel/postal delivery and logistics services for consumer and commercial customers.

candidates.name: Royal Mail
candidates.description: Both provide comprehensive parcel and mail delivery infrastructure for national and international logistics.
candidates.rationale: Both are large postal and parcel delivery/logistics providers serving similar customers and shipping needs.

candidates.name: S.F. Express Co. Ltd
candidates.description: Both are major express delivery companies with their own air cargo fleets and ground networks.
candidates.rationale: Direct peer: both are global express logistics and parcel delivery companies with similar shipping, freight, and supply-chain offerings.

candidates.name: OnTrac Logistics, Inc.
candidates.description: Both focus on providing fast, reliable e-commerce parcel delivery services and last-mile logistics.
candidates.rationale: Directly comparable parcel delivery and last-mile logistics provider; same business model and buyer audience as FedEx.

candidates.name: CEVA Logistics
candidates.description: Both offer global supply chain management and transport logistics across air, ocean, and ground.
candidates.rationale: Same global logistics and supply-chain services business, serving similar shipping and transport customers.

candidates.name: GEODIS
candidates.description: Both are worldwide transport and logistics leaders providing integrated end-to-end supply chain services.
candidates.rationale: Same global logistics and supply-chain services business, serving similar enterprise shipping and transportation customers.

candidates.name: Blue Dart
candidates.description: Both operate as express logistics service providers with integrated air and ground distribution networks.
candidates.rationale: Same express logistics business model and customer base; Blue Dart is a clear FedEx-like lookalike.

candidates.name: Expeditors International
candidates.description: Both operate global logistics platforms providing air freight, ocean freight, and customs brokerage services.
candidates.rationale: Same global logistics and transportation category; comparable freight, customs, and supply-chain services to similar shippers.

candidates.name: GLS Group
candidates.description: Both provide international parcel and logistics services with a strong focus on cross-border delivery reliability.
candidates.rationale: Same business model: global parcel/logistics carrier serving similar shipping customers and cross-border delivery needs.
